At Guthrie Kitchen & Bath Plus, we don’t just do kitchen remodeling! Our services range from complete designs to end-to-end design/build services to selection and ordering of products. Guthrie Kitchen & Bath Plus LLC is your one-stop-shop for all the products you need to bring out the best in your home. Guthrie Kitchen & Bath Plus LLC has been transforming home living spaces in our community since January 2013. Take a look at our recently completed projects to get inspired and see examples of our work. Let us help you create the kitchen or bathroom design you always wanted.

CONTEMPORARY STYLE AND STORAGE IN CLARKSVILLE
This contemporary kitchen remodel in Clarksville, TN combines classic white cabinetry with striking design accents to create a beautiful, bright kitchen.

Stunning green glass wall tile from Lia turns this shower into an eye catching focal point.

ABOUT GUTHRIE KITCHEN & BATH PLUS

Our team proudly serves the community of Pleasant View and the surrounding region. As a local business and residents of the community, we have a keen understanding what homeowners in our area require. As experts in our industry, we also have an in-depth knowledge of the latest products, styles, and techniques that will help you achieve your dream home design. Our goal is to create designs and offer products that cater to your family’s lifestyle challenges, desires, and budget. We also recognize that updating your home is not a one-size-fits-all endeavor. That is why we offer such a wide range of products and services, to enable us to meet the needs of clients who require a large scale remodel while also helping our neighbors who simply want a fresh coat of paint to brighten up a room.

NOT READY FOR A FULL RENOVATION?

You don’t always need a full renovation to make a big impact. New vanities, updated fixtures, fresh tilework, and modern lighting can completely refresh your bathroom. Ask our designers about affordable ways to enhance your home.

EXPLORE YOUR OPTIONS

Are you ready to update your master bath to a luxury spa-style retreat? Do you need to create a hall bath design suited to your young children and growing family? Or do you want to remodel an existing bathroom or add a first-floor full bathroom designed for aging in place? We can help you create the perfect bathroom designs to fit your home, your family’s needs, and your personal style.

Today’s bathrooms are more than purely functional spaces. They are where you start and end each day, and often serve as a relaxing retreat within your home and busy life. A well-designed bathroom can help you stay organized as you get ready for your day. It can also be your go-to place to wind down with a soak in the tub or a soothing steam shower.

Our experienced design team will help you get the most out of your bathroom layout. We can create a design that works within your existing space or help you expand your bathroom footprint with structural changes. Our team will work with you to find the perfect products, colors, and materials to bring your bathroom design vision to life. 

Let us take the stress out of the remodeling process! Updating your bathroom can seem overwhelming with so many decisions to make – from selecting a layout to choosing a vanity cabinet, tiles, flooring, plumbing fixtures, and accessories. Rely on our expertise and knowledge as we guide you through creating a design, choosing products, and completing your remodel to the highest standards. Get started by contacting our team!

CONTACT US

Your bathroom design needs will vary depending on your personal preferences, available space, accessibility requirements, budget, and more. Start by considering which bathroom you are designing.

If you are updating your powder room or another half bathroom you will typically only require a sink, toilet, and small vanity cabinet to store essentials.

Powder rooms are also an ideal space to experiment with your style by introducing bold color choices, patterned tiles or wallpaper, and fun accessories.

A busy family bathroom or master bath requires enough storage to keep everyone organized. You will also need a toilet plus a shower, tub, or both.

Choose a style and color scheme that fits your home’s design aesthetic and that will create a soothing atmosphere for the bathroom’s users.
 If accessibility is a top priority, we have the expertise to help you create a bathroom that is as safe as it is stylish. Choose from a range of non-slip flooring materials, thresholdless or open shower styles, and easy-to-access doorways.

Make sure your bathroom storage is easy to reach and include plenty of lighting throughout the bathroom. Add accessibility features like grab bars in key locations, with materials and finishes that match your other design features.

MULTI-SPACE REMODELING MADE EASY

If your remodeling needs go beyond a single room or a simple style update, the Guthrie Kitchen and Bath Plus LLC team has you covered. Whether you require a multi-room remodel or a home addition, our team will work with you to create the home of your dreams. With our proven design process, team of experts, and years of experience, we know exactly what it takes to make every remodeling project a success.

Start by considering your remodeling goals. Are you updating your first floor with new flooring, a kitchen remodel, laundry room update, home office design, and a fresh powder room design? Or perhaps you plan to remodel your master suite with new bedroom flooring, a custom closet design, and a spa-style master bathroom remodel? Do you love your home’s location but desperately need to add on more space to your kitchen or create a new family room?

Identify your key objectives and then visit our Pleasant View showroom to browse styles, see products first-hand, and talk to our team. We will walk you through every step of the remodeling process to make sure your project is stress-free and successful. Let’s work together to create your ideal home!

A multi-space remodel or home addition may seem like a daunting task but it is also an opportunity to bring your dream home to life. We have experience working on design and remodeling projects of all sizes, with a proven track record in delivering value for your remodeling investment. Our team will make sure every detail is handled, from concept to completion, including obtaining permits, ordering products, and carefully managing the timeline for all elements of your project.

Best of all, our Pleasant View, TN showroom is the only location you need to visit to find everything you need to complete your project. No need for endless online searches or driving to multiple locations. View samples first-hand and let your experienced Guthrie designer help you find the perfect products to complete your design. CUSTOM CLOSETS MONTGOMERY COUNTY
CUSTOM CLOSET DESIGN SERVICES
CUSTOM PANTRY AND CLOSET SYSTEMS

A custom closet design transforms your space to fit your lifestyle and improve your home’s efficiency. Whether you want to create a master closet design or to update your hall closet, linen closet, or any space that benefits from custom storage, our experienced design and remodeling team can help. We will work with you to understand your individual needs and create a storage plan tailored to your requirements.

Custom closets, particularly for a busy master suite, offer more than just efficient storage. They enhance your daily routine with an organized, well-lit, easy to navigate space that blends with your home’s design aesthetic. In a walk-in closet, you can include custom shelving, drawers equipped with special storage features for clothing and accessories, shoe storage, and bars at different heights for hanging clothes. Include essential lighting so you can see clearly, and enhance your closet’s style with decorative light fixtures.

Other closets, such as a kids’ bedroom closet, hall closet, linen closet, or even a pantry cabinet benefits from customize storage solutions with adjustable shelves, bars and hooks for hanging items, and pull out containers that make contents easy to access. Our experienced team will work with you to understand your requirements and create a storage plan that is catered to your individual needs.

CONTACT US

A fresh start for your closet storage not only improves organization and reduces clutter, it also enhances your home’s value and your daily routine. We all know how frustrating it can be when trying to get ready for work or a night out and you can’t find that perfect outfit or pair of shoes. A new closet design maximizes your available closet space, creating room to neatly store everything you need so it can be easily found.

A closet design is an ideal add-on to a kitchen remodel, bathroom design, or whole home update. We apply our design expertise and creativity to every project and can help you find the perfect storage solutions to enhance your home and lifestyle. Start by visiting our Pleasant View showroom or contact us to speak to a member of our team about your project. We would love to meet with you to review your plans in more detail and discuss how we can help you bring your design vision to life.

FIREPLACE SURROUNDS IN NASHVILLE
FIREPLACE SURROUND DESIGN
DESIGN A COZY FIREPLACE SURROUND

A fireplace design combines beauty and functionality to serve as the centerpiece of living spaces in your home. Fireplaces bring warmth to any room and help to create an inviting atmosphere where you can relax or spend time with guests. If your fireplaces need to be updated, our experienced team can help you create the perfect style and find the ideal materials to add comfort and value to your home.

At Guthrie Kitchen and Bath Plus LLC we have the experience and knowledge to handle all your home remodeling needs. We can help you craft a custom fireplace design that is tailored to your home’s style and your needs. You will be amazed at how a new fireplace will transform your living spaces. Our team will help you identify your design style and select the perfect materials to seamlessly integrate with your room’s décor. Whether you plan to remodel your fireplace as part of a living room style update or a complete first floor remodel, work with the Guthrie team to get the best results.

CONTACT US

Our team will ensure that every detail is carefully planned and implemented to create the fireplace you always wanted for your living room. Whether you are looking for a sleek, modern fireplace with clean lines or a more traditional hearth with a decorative mantle, we can help you bring your fireplace design vision to life. Beyond the core functional components of a fireplace, there are several key elements to consider when planning your fireplace update, including:

Surround – this is the area outside of your firebox. You can choose a range of materials to surround your fireplace including natural stone, tile, or brick, to create a striking style for your living room’s focal point.
Hearth – this is the floor that extends in front of the firebox. Choose a hearth material that enhances your functionality and style with a safe and durable surface.
Mantle – this is like a shelf above your fireplace and can be as simple or ornate as you like. Select a material and style that complements your room’s design aesthetic, whether that is rustic, contemporary, or traditional. The mantle can also be a place to display decorative items such as framed photographs, allowing you to further personalize your space.

NASHVILLE COUNTERTOP INSTALLATION
KITCHEN COUNTERTOP INSTALLATION
QUARTZ AND GRANITE COUNTERTOPS

For kitchens, bathrooms, utility rooms, and more, countertops are key to your design’s style and functionality. Countertops immediately draw the eye when you walk into a kitchen or bathroom, since they cover such a large, visible surface area. The material, color, veining, and edge you select for your countertops work together with cabinetry and backsplash to help define your room’s style. Your chosen material will also vary widely in terms of durability, heat-resistance, and ease of maintenance.

Carefully consider your design aesthetic when selecting a countertop material, so you can look for one that elevates your home’s style. Think about which space you are remodeling, how you plan to use that space, and how long you plan to stay in your home. A kitchen remodel in your forever home will benefit from investing in a luxury material that will last as long as your kitchen design. On the other hand, a laundry room might work better with a more budget-friendly option. With a wide range of quality countertop materials available, we can help you find the perfect one to fit your needs.

CONTACT US

The Guthrie Kitchen & Bath Plus LLC team is here to help with all your home remodeling needs. When it comes to choosing a countertop material, our Pleasant View, TN showroom is the only place you need to visit. Our experienced designers can talk to you about your requirements, look at your room’s style, discuss your functional needs, and consider your budget. We will help you find the perfect material to fit your needs and to complement your other design features. Our showroom offers samples and design displays so you can see and feel the materials first-hand.

When you visit our showroom, you can browse samples and ask our experienced team questions to help you understand the pros and cons of each material. Some of the popular options for countertops include luxury materials like granite and quartz, natural options like marble and wood, and budget-friendly laminate. Quartz is one of the most popular choices as it offers the perfect balance of moisture and heat-resistance, easy maintenance, and timeless style.

With Guthrie Kitchen and Bath Plus LLC you can feel confident you are getting the best selection of products and services available in our area. Our experienced design and remodeling team is here to help you with all your home remodeling needs, from kitchen to bathrooms, laundry rooms, multi-space remodels, and more. 

Flooring and tile are a key element of any home design. Your floor material must be able to withstand foot traffic, pets, spills, and heavy items. The material that is right for you will vary depending on your home’s style, your family, and the room you are updating. Tile also features in other key areas of kitchen and bath designs, including bathroom walls, shower floors, and backsplashes.

With our partner company, Guthrie Flooring, we can offer you the best selection of products ranging from hardwood to luxury vinyl, tile, carpet, and much more. CONTACT US

Your chosen flooring and tile create surfaces in your home that enhance your design while meeting your needs for durability and easy maintenance.  Assess which room you are remodeling and how this space will be used. Is it a room prone to moisture and spills? Is it a busy room with daily foot traffic? Do you have pets who will be walking in and out of this room? Are you willing to follow a careful cleaning and maintenance routine? These questions and more will help you assess your needs and find the ideal materials for your remodel.

Flooring materials range from hardwood to tile, luxury vinyl plank/tile (LVP/T), laminate, carpet, and more. Different materials fit specific areas of your home better, and each has its pros and cons. It’s important to explore your needs, budget, and style preferences with a design professional when choosing the right flooring material for your remodel.

Tile is also used for backsplashes, tub surrounds, and shower enclosures. Tile is one of the oldest materials and is still a popular choice for today’s homes for flooring and much more. It is a versatile material that can be found in an array of sizes, colors, patterns, and shapes to give your room a unique style.

LAUNDRY ROOM DESIGN AND REMODEL
CUSTOM LAUNDRY AND UTILITY ROOMS

The Guthrie Kitchen and Bath Plus LLC team is here to help with all your home remodeling needs. We know that you require well-planned, organized, and stylish spaces to keep your home life running smoothly, from kitchens to bathrooms, living rooms, and more.

A well-designed laundry or utility room can transform your daily routine and make the most mundane household chores easier, more efficient, and maybe even more enjoyable! With our experienced design team, we can help you create a beautiful and functional laundry room that is tailored to your available space, your style, and your specific requirements. We put our design expertise and creativity to work to help you maximize storage for laundry and cleaning supplies, improve your room’s layout, and enhance your style.

An upgrade to your laundry room benefits your daily life and your home’s value with improved organization and functionality. We can help you upgrade your existing laundry room, move your laundry to a better location in your home, or add a new laundry room. Your laundry room design can benefit from cabinetry with smart storage solutions to hold everything from laundry products to cleaning supplies and pet paraphernalia. Decide how you plan to use your laundry room and create storage to meet your needs.

CONTACT US

There are several questions to ask yourself when planning your laundry room design. How big is your laundry room? Do you plan to use it solely for laundry, or will it also serve as a general utility room? Will you also use this room for pet products or include a dog washing station? Is this a room where you will wash and dry clothes, or do you also plan to sort, fold, and iron in your laundry room?

Create customized storage  and include pull out hampers to sort your dirty clothes before washing them. Include space to hang delicates to dry, and add room to store your iron and ironing board. Countertop space is ideal for folding laundry, while  a utility sink lets you handwash or rinse tough stains and dirt before washing. Enhance your space by choosing a color scheme, materials, lighting, and accessories that make your laundry room stylish and enjoyable.

MIDDLE TENNESSEE CABINET EXPERTS
CUSTOM KITCHEN AND BATH CABINETS
CABINETRY TO FIT EVERY ROOM

If you have a space in your home that would benefit from storage, we have the cabinetry you need. Our wide selection includes stock, semi-custom, and fully custom cabinetry. A cabinet design is not just for your kitchen. Cabinetry enhances many home living spaces from kitchens to bathrooms, laundry rooms to living rooms. Cabinets form the foundation of your room’s layout, define your style and color scheme, and provide essential storage and workspace.

Let our experienced team help you find the perfect cabinetry to suit your design style, as well as your budget, storage needs, and layout. Start by examining your space to determine what type and how much storage you need. Look at the shape of your room and start planning the layout that will fit your space best. Think about your home’s style and the aesthetic you want to create with your new design.

Then start browsing cabinet materials, styles, and finishes to find the perfect choice for your home. You can find inspiration online or visit our full-service Pleasant View showroom to view design displays and cabinet samples first-hand. This lets you not only see and feel the cabinet doors, but also how they work together with your chosen countertop, tiles, cabinet hardware, and more. Next, consider the storage accessories that sit behind your cabinet doors and help you maintain a clutter-free room. We will work with you to customize your storage to keep even the smallest items organized and accessible.

KITCHEN CABINETS
KITCHEN CABINETS

Kitchen cabinets are the foundation of your kitchen’s layout. They establish your workspaces, provide storage, and set up the flow of traffic throughout your kitchen design. They also set the tone for your room’s style with the door style, material, color, and finish. They are the centerpiece of your kitchen and should be chosen with a quality and style that will last.

BATH VANITY CABINETS
BATH VANITY CABINETS

Bathroom vanity requirements vary widely, depending on the type of bathroom you are designing and your personal needs. Vanities provide essential and functional customized storage in your busy bathrooms, where you can store everything from toiletries and makeup to spare rolls of toilet paper. They also influence your room’s style with your choice of cabinet style and finish, combined with cabinet hardware.

LAUNDRY AND UTILITY CABINETS
LAUNDRY AND UTILITY CABINETS

We know your busy home requires cabinet storage in more than just the kitchen and bathrooms. Laundry, utility, and mud rooms are essential spaces in any home and benefit from storage for all your laundry, cleaning, and pet supplies. Choose cabinets that fit your home’s design aesthetic to create a space that is pleasant as well as functional!

LIVING ROOM CABINETS
LIVING ROOM CABINETS

In a modern home, living rooms are places to live, relax, and spend time with family and friends. Enhance your living room design with cabinets that customize your space. Your cabinets can blend with your room or stand out as a focal point, while also creating storage for books, board games, kids’ art supplies, and much more.

CUSTOM WOOD PRODUCTS
CUSTOM WOOD PRODUCTS

Custom Wood Products has been offering quality custom cabinetry since 1981, building a company based on integrity, where employees could be proud of the products they produce. They partner with independently owned kitchen and bath design centers like Guthrie Kitchen & Bath Plus LLC. Their cabinetry offers custom sizes, features, finishes, shapes, and designs, where each client’s cabinetry is made to order. They bring the craftsmanship of an old-fashioned woodworker to their products and stand by their quality, making them an excellent choice for a custom kitchen or bath design.

HOLIDAY KITCHENS

At Holiday Kitchens, quality doesn’t simply mean exceptional materials and craftsmanship. It means creating kitchen cabinetry tailored to the needs and desires of the customer. Whether you prefer the warm comfort of traditional kitchens, the sleek lines and rich tones of today’s European-style kitchens, or the personality of mixed colors and textures in the eclectic kitchens, Holiday Kitchens’ custom cabinet designs are always modeled on the way you live.

VIEW SELECTION

MARSH CABINETRY

Marsh Cabinets is a family-owned cabinetry manufacturer with a century-long legacy of innovation, reliability, and service. Established in 1906, it has grown into a key player in the cabinetry industry across the eastern U.S. Their website offers style galleries to inspire homeowners and designers, a style selector tool for customizing cabinetry selections, and information on finding Marsh dealers. It highlights the company’s American-made commitment and its ambition for continued growth and service excellence.

From its founding in 1997 when it started with only one line of oak kitchen cabinets, it has grown to over 20 styles of kitchen and bath cabinets today, all available for immediate delivery. JSI’s impressive range backs up its mission statement: “To provide affordable fashion for
today’s home.”

To achieve this goal, CNC provides a large selection of affordable, high-quality kitchen cabinets, countertops, and vanity cabinets. Their products provide value for money, balancing design, quality, and price. CNC has 20 years of experience and innovation in producing accessible cabinet lines, with a loyal client base, and a team dedicated to their brand and quality.

WAYPOINT LIVING SPACES

Waypoint understands that no one remodels their home every year, and therefore your cabinetry needs to be durable and able to meet your functional and style needs for years to come. They offer stylish cabinet designs in the highest quality materials with a lifetime, limited warranty. The Waypoint team prides itself on its high level of craftsmanship, with solid hardwood frames, top-quality materials, and a high standard of construction that meets the rigorous standards set by the American National Standards Institute. Guthrie Kitchen & Bath Plus LLC is the top destination in Pleasant View and the surrounding area for countertops to suit any style or budget. STONE KITCHEN COUNTERTOPS
GRANITE

Granite is an igneous rock that forms when magma cools slowly beneath the earth's surface, forming large, easily visible crystals of quartz, feldspar, and mica. Scientifically, an intrusive (plutonic) igneous rock must contain between 10% and 50% quartz to be classified as granite.

MARBLE

Marble is a metamorphic stone formed when limestone is subjected to intense heat, pressure and chemical solutions, causing the stone to reform into an interlocking structure of calcite, aragonite, and sometimes dolomite crystals.

LIMESTONE

Limestone is a sedimentary rock composed of calcium carbonate, plus calcium and/or magnesium. It is formed when layers of minerals (particularly calcite), fine sediment, and the skeletons and shells of marine organisms undergo lithification.
